'''Lett-Shara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was married to a [[Lett-Shara (Moff)|Moff]] of the Empire, and the captain was considered to be a fine [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] player and a scribe of the [[Ilthmar Gambit]], according to [[Vector Hyllus]] and [[Eckard Lokin]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was assigned to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Razer]] and coordinated the assault on the [[Aegis Base]] along with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nedecca]], Major [[Sanos]] and former Intelligence Agent [[Cipher Nine]].
